edits.old: I want to personally thank Steve Miller for sharing his insights with me. While I was formulating this concept of the Origin Salon, because Steve relayed to me that we should really see this as an important historical record, not only of the artist who will be presenting, but also contextually, as a prehistory of Techspressionism. And it's really neat, because I think those early days are now reflected into today's text artists worldwide, who are using things like augmented reality. VR AI nfts web 3 and much more.
